reconcile.note: Matthew Henry explains the two named sons in Chronicles 29 as zealous volunteers singled out for a task, not an exhaustive list of Heman's fourteen sons.

sides.snippet: Of Heman; the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth
sides.verseText: Of Heman; the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.

sides.snippet: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei
sides.verseText: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
